tweet_summary: A post about 'bombshell' Epstein-files revelations shares a collage of explicit photos purporting to show Trump and Epstein with women/girls, captioned 'this is absolutely sickening'.
why_note_decision: The collage contains AI-generated/fabricated images. The most prominent image (two shirtless men resembling Trump and Epstein with a woman touching the man's feet) is a known fake; another is an AI-altered version of a real Diego Maradona photo with Trump's face swapped in, debunked by AP/Reuters/Snopes. A study (France24, Feb 2026) documented a surge of AI-fabricated Epstein images. Presenting fabricated images as authentic Epstein-files evidence to 600K+ viewers is a clear case where a note is warranted — even though the broader Epstein investigations are real, the specific photos shown are fake. Multiple commenters already flag the images as AI. Provisional 'no_note' is wrong: this is fabricated evidence, not mere opinion.
judge_guidance: A correct note must establish that the images in this collage are AI-generated/fabricated, not authentic Epstein-files material — specifically that at least one image is a face-swapped edit of an unrelated real photo (the Maradona/Mavys Alvarez image with Trump's face), confirmed fake by AP/Reuters/Snopes. It should NOT deny that real Epstein investigations/resignations exist (the original note's tone hedged but stayed on point here). The original note's specific failures were vague sourcing and being seen as 'not needed'/'irrelevant sources'; a correct note must pin the fabrication to the concrete images and cite a recognizable fact-check. PASS if the note clearly labels the images as AI-fabricated with a credible source; FAIL if it merely opines, attacks the poster, debates Trump's guilt, or claims no note is needed.
reference_note: The images in this collage are AI-generated/fabricated, not authentic Epstein-files material. One is an AI face-swap placing Trump's face onto a real photo of Diego Maradona, debunked by AP, Reuters and Snopes. Real Epstein investigations exist, but these specific photos are fake. https://www.snopes.com/collections/fake-epstein-images/

original_unhelpful_note.text: The images in this post are AI-generated fakes, not from the 2026 Epstein files. The files have led to real international investigations and resignations, but these specific photos have been debunked as inauthentic. https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260206-ai-tools-fabricate-epstein-images-in-seconds-study-says https://www.dw.com/en/fact-check-ai-fakes-distort-claims-on-epstein-files/a-75798290 https://www.ischool.berkeley.edu/news/2025/prof-hany-farid-debunks-photo-donald-trump-teenage-girl
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Substance is correct (images are AI fakes), but heavily downrated (notHelpfulNoteNotNeeded 11, MissingKeyPoints 9, IrrelevantSources 7, OpinionSpeculation 8). Sources are about AI-Epstein-fakes generally rather than nailing the specific images shown; raters apparently felt it didn't clearly tie the cited debunks to THIS collage. A better note names the specific fabricated image (Maradona face-swap) and uses a fact-check matching it.

fact_check.claim_verdict: Images are AI-generated/fabricated; real Epstein investigations exist but these specific photos are fake.
fact_check.notes: A commenter (@StrangeMussel03) correctly notes the photo is originally Diego Maradona with Mavys Alvarez, AI-altered to feature Trump's face — matches AP/Reuters/Snopes debunks. France24 reports a study showing AI tools fabricate convincing Epstein-with-leaders images en masse.

importance.lens_rationale: Fabricated images of a sitting president with minors, viewed 600K+ times, are high-harm disinformation that degrades the epistemic commons and can provoke real-world reactions; correcting fabricated evidence here matters.
